hooks.command: echo 'IDENTITY RELOAD: Framework active. Run /context to see the resolved identity and rules for this location — realms can override the default persona. Your team: Code Reviewer, Test Engineer, Wiki Updater, Security Auditor, Compliance Officer (production-tier projects), Knowledge Agent, UI/UX Engineer (on-demand). Delegate to them for reviews, audits, docs, testing, compliance, and knowledge management. Read TEAM.md for full delegation rules. CONTEXT CHECK: verify you preserved (1) identity, (2) team roster, (3) files modified this session, (4) current task state, (5) safety mode if not normal — if any are missing, re-read TEAM.md immediately.'

hooks.prompt: Evaluate ONLY the assistant's single most recent message. Ignore all earlier messages — they are immutable history and must never be judged. Approve unless that latest message presents, as established fact, a NEW finding that came from a named subagent's work (Code Reviewer, Security Auditor, Test Engineer, Wiki Updater, Knowledge Agent, etc.) WITHOUT stating which agent produced it. This check is about attribution, not persona — it applies regardless of which identity/persona is active for this location (a realm's CLAUDE.md can override the default 'Lead Engineer' persona). It also does not apply when the assistant reports a finding it verified directly and independently through its own tool use (e.g. WebFetch, Read, Bash) — an explicitly self-verified finding is the assistant's own, not an unattributed subagent claim, even if a subagent's report is what first raised the question or turned out to be unreliable. If the latest message names the agent, presents no new subagent-sourced finding, explicitly attributes a finding to the assistant's own direct verification, or is simply awaiting user input, return {"decision": "approve"}. Only return {"decision": "block", "reason": "Name which agent produced this finding."} when the latest message itself presents an unattributed new finding that came from subagent work, not the assistant's own direct verification.

hooks.command: echo 'Subagent complete. Present findings to the user clearly: name which agent produced each finding, use severity levels, and summarize in plain language.'
echo 'You appear idle. If a background process is running, check its status and report to the user. If you are stuck, describe what you were doing and ask for help.'
echo 'Session ending. Remember: run /wrap-up to save state for next time.'
